info.title: Airport Keeper External API
info.description:
## Security"

  The security is done using HTTP Bearer Token.

  The token is provided based on the user identification via `/login` route using accredited `username` and `password` in the header of the request result under the `Authorization` key.

  This token should be put in the header of each request under the `Authorization` key.

  ## Date-time format

  Date and date-time fields are in standard internet format as defined in ISO 8601 i.e.

  * `date = yyyy-MM-dd`, for example `2017-07-06`;

  * `date-time = yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`, for example `2017-07-06T12:00:00Z`.

  ## Versioning

  Versioning is required to support existing clients when a major change is made to the API that is not backwards compatible.

  The client will request a specific version by specifying the version number in the URL. If the version is not specified then the oldest supported version is assumed.

status.description:
HTTP response error status.

HTTP status is a three-digit integer, where the first digit of the status code defines the class of response. There are five classes defined by the standard:
* 1xx - informational response – the request was received, continuing process
* 2xx - successful             – the request was successfully received, understood, and accepted
* 3xx - redirection            – further action needs to be taken in order to complete the request
* 4xx - client error           – the request contains bad syntax or cannot be fulfilled
* 5xx - server error           – the server failed to fulfil an apparently valid request

FlightMilestoneDto.description:
The flight milestone:
- SCHEDULED - for ARR flight: flight is scheduled but not yet airborne; for DEP flight: preceding arrival flight is scheduled but not yet airborne
- AIRBORNE - for ARR flight only: flight is airborne
- FIR_ENTRY - for ARR flight only: flight entered FIR
- FINAL - for ARR flight only: flight is in final approach
- LANDED - for ARR flight only: flight has landed
- IN_BLOCK - for ARR flight only: flight is at the block
- NO_IN_BLOCK - for DEP flight only: preceding arrival flight is airborne or landed but not yet at the block
- ON_BLOCK - for DEP flight only: preceding arrival flight is at the block but the departure operations have not yet started
- START_BOARDING - for DEP flight only: boarding started
- AC_READY - for DEP flight only: the aircraft is ready for departure
- OK_START - for DEP flight only: the aircraft was given clearance to depart
- OFF_BLOCK - for DEP flight only: the flight has left the block
- TAKE_OFF - for DEP flight only: the flight has taken off

FlightStatusDto.description:
The flight global status:
- SCHEDULED - flight is scheduled but not yet airborne
- IN_FLIGHT - flight is airborne
- SUSPENDED - flight is suspended by the network manager
- TERMINATED - flight has terminated
- CANCELLED - flight is cancelled
- NONE - undefined

GhrRecordStatusDto.description:
The GHR flight record progress status:
- ADDED - the record was created and is in progress
- TERMINATED - the record is terminated (all required actions fulfilled)

OpenStatusDto.description:
The resource open / close status (applied for check-in, gate, boarding, baggage belt):
- NOT_STARTED - the action requiring the resource not started yet
- OPEN - the resource is open / action has started
- CLOSED - the resource is closed / the action has terminated
